title: parse_sig_param splits on comma without handling quoted-string values
description: activitypub/inbound.rs parse_sig_param() splits the Signature header on ',' to find params. RFC 7235 / Cavage HTTP Signatures allow the signature= value itself to be a base64 string which may not contain commas, but other param values (keyId, headers) routinely contain content that could confuse a naive split. More critically, the 'headers' param value like 'headers="(request-target) host date digest"' contains a quoted string — the current split on ',' would fail if any quoted value contained a comma. This is fragile and will break against non-trivial Signature headers.
